import pytest
import sqlglot
from sqlglot.errors import ParseError


def test_insert_replace_using():
    sql = """
INSERT INTO TABLE students
    REPLACE USING (country)
    SELECT * FROM new_students;
"""
    with pytest.raises(ParseError) as exc_info:
        sqlglot.parse_one(sql, dialect="databricks")

    # Assert that the error message indicates an unexpected token related to "REPLACE"
    assert "Unexpected token 'REPLACE'" in str(exc_info.value)
